answers.question: Question 13: When the call that asks staff to follow up gets no answer, what does the agent do? Two of your earlier answers read differently: one says "handoff timeout not retried", the other says "On timeout, retry once; if it times out again, tell the customer to contact Harbor Goods support." Under the first, the agent sends one follow-up call and, when it gets no answer, tells the customer what happened and asks them to contact Harbor Goods support. Under the second, it sends the follow-up call once more first, and could then create two tasks for one order if the first call did create its task. Claims put to the owner: C-21.
answers.recommended: The follow-up call is not resent. When it gets no answer, the agent tells the customer what happened and asks them to contact Harbor Goods support.
answers.reply: > 3. request_staff_followup is idempotent on (order_number, reason) — add as SG-03. On timeout, retry once; if it times out again, tell the customer to contact Harbor Goods support.
